breakdown.description: The pipe is simultaneously described as horizontal/same elevation and having a 15 m elevation difference (contradictory geometry).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt was contradictory, stating the pipe was both horizontal (same elevation) and had a 15 m elevation difference. The generated specification correctly resolved this by ignoring the incorrect 'horizontal' description and using the 15 m elevation difference in the Bernoulli equation ('z₂ = z₁ + 15 m'). This aligns with the ground truth's correction to treat the pipe as not horizontal.
